name: Food Blast with The Mask
author: Aminur
description:
Hello! Our game is a mish-mash of wackiness, action, and a sense of adventure. Food Blast with The Mask salutes three different types of classics: Jim Carrey's character in the 1994 movie, "The Mask", is our main character with shapeshifting abilities, a legendary video game The Prince of Persia which inspires our world design and gameplay, and lastly, familiar foods that are classic meals which many people can identify with. It's a trip down memory lane, perhaps a blast from our past for some of us! We had lots of fun designing this game. Hope you enjoy!

How-To-Play: A D (movement), W S E and left-click (abilities)
